reconcile.note: Gill reads Numbers 1:49 as barring Levi only from the general census, since Levi was later numbered separately for tabernacle service.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Wells presses the plain reading that God first forbids Moses to number Levi among Israel and then, in the same book, commands him to do exactly that.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible (2013).

sides.snippet: \"Only the tribe of Levi you shall not number, neither shall you take a census of them among the children of Israel;
sides.verseText: \"Only the tribe of Levi you shall not number, neither shall you take a census of them among the children of Israel;

sides.snippet: \"Number the children of Levi by their fathers' houses, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shall you number.\"
sides.verseText: \"Number the children of Levi by their fathers' houses, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shall you number.\"
